chunks: And give me as assistant from my family
ai.seo_question: Who did Prophet Hud ask God to appoint as his helper from his family?
ai.summary: While commonly attributed to Prophet Hud, this verse is more widely recognized in Shia and Sunni exegesis as part of Prophet Moses' (Musa) supplication in Surah Taha, where he requests his brother Aaron (Harun) as his vizier to strengthen his mission. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the concept of 'Wilayah' and the strategic importance of appointing capable, trusted family members or successors to ensure the continuity and efficacy of divine leadership. The request underscores the interdependence of spiritual authority and administrative support in establishing religious order.
